tools.name: ewdoc_compose
tools.description: Draft one complete bounded document recipe as a single previewable proposal and one Undo unit. The first step defines the document; following steps define body blocks.

contextRef.description: Exact revision-scoped context returned by document status.

tools.name: ewdoc_discard
tools.description: Discard a draft change set without changing the document.

tools.name: ewdoc_draft
tools.description: Create a draft HTML block edit or append one to an exact unpreviewed change set. Review actions use ewdoc_review. Preview and commit are separate.

changeSetId.description: Existing unpreviewed change set id to append to.

target.description: Handle such as B1 or R1.

tools.name: ewdoc_format
tools.description: Set explicit desired character or paragraph formatting on an exact text handle, creating or appending to an unpreviewed atomic change set.

changeSetId.description: Existing unpreviewed change set id to append to.

target.description: Text block or range handle such as B1 or R1.

fontSizePt.description: Font size in points; values are normalized to 1-400.

textColor.description: Hex color, or null to clear.

highlightColor.description: Hex color, or null to clear.

lineSpacing.description: Line spacing; values are normalized to 0.5-4.

leftIndentPt.description: Left indent in points; values are normalized to 0-432.

rightIndentPt.description: Right indent in points; values are normalized to 0-432.

firstLineIndentPt.description: First-line indent in points; values are normalized to -432 through 432.

spacingBeforePt.description: Space before in points; values are normalized to 0-144.

spacingAfterPt.description: Space after in points; values are normalized to 0-144.

tools.name: ewdoc_go_to
tools.description: Select and reveal an exact target handle from its current semantic context.

target.description: Handle such as B1, R1, T1, C1, or A1.

selection.description: Select the target or collapse at one boundary.

tools.name: ewdoc_insert
tools.description: Draft one bounded text, table, approved local picture, shape, chart, header/footer, field, page number, TOC, or business-template insertion at an exact block handle.

kind.description: Visible local picker; paths, URLs, and raw bytes are not accepted.

altText.description: Alternative text for an image or shape.

fillColor.description: Six-digit hex color, or none for shape fill.

tools.name: ewdoc_layout
tools.description: Draft bounded page setup or page-numbering changes for the section containing an exact top-level target.

tools.name: ewdoc_link
tools.description: Draft one safe hyperlink replacement at an exact range handle.

tools.name: ewdoc_new
tools.description: Create and activate one new unsaved document through the Documents host. This does not save a file.

tools.name: ewdoc_object
tools.description: Draft bounded alternative-text or size changes for an exact image block; source and asset changes are not exposed.

tools.name: ewdoc_outline
tools.description: Read the active E-Worker document outline and compact edit handles.

tools.name: ewdoc_preview
tools.description: Preview a draft change set before commit.

tools.name: ewdoc_read
tools.description: Read semantic HTML near a supplied handle or the current selection.

target.description: Handle such as B1 or R1.

tools.name: ewdoc_request_open
tools.description: Request one host-governed open action. Browser picker, desktop path, and Engine reference variants are revalidated against the declared host mode.

tools.name: ewdoc_request_save
tools.description: Request a host-governed local save or save-copy. The editor owns the destination and may require visible user action.

mode.description: Save the current document or create a separate local copy.

tools.name: ewdoc_review
tools.description: Draft one comment add, reply, resolve, or reopen action against an exact content or annotation handle.

tools.name: ewdoc_search
tools.description: Search the active E-Worker document and return compact handles.

tools.name: ewdoc_status
tools.description: Read active document, selection, protection, view, and supported semantic capabilities.

tools.name: ewdoc_switch
tools.description: Without documentRef, list bounded opaque references for open documents. With documentRef, activate that exact open document.

documentRef.description: Opaque reference returned by this mounted Documents session.

tools.name: ewdoc_table
tools.description: Draft one bounded table caption edit on an exact table handle; unsupported table variants fail explicitly.

tools.name: ewnotes_attachment
tools.description: Rename or delete one exact attachment, or ask the user to choose one local file before drafting add or replace. Paths, URLs, and raw bytes are rejected.

tools.name: ewnotes_blocks
tools.description: Draft bounded ordered text, checklist, table, code, or callout block changes against exact opaque targets.

beforeContextId.description: Context for the exact block destination.

tools.name: ewnotes_checklist
tools.description: Draft one exact checklist completion-state change.

tools.name: ewnotes_commit
tools.description: Request visible approval and a verified restore point or explicit waiver, then commit one reversible Notes Undo action.

tools.name: ewnotes_compose
tools.description: Draft one complete notebook from a closed bounded notebook, section, note, text, checklist, and table recipe. Replaces the active notebook only after preview and approval as one Undo step.

tools.name: ewnotes_discard
tools.description: Discard one exact Notes draft and any approval lease without changing the notebook.

tools.name: ewnotes_format
tools.description: Draft bounded block, text-range, or paragraph formatting on one exact block. Use camelCase format fields; preview and approval remain required.

tools.name: ewnotes_go_to
tools.description: Select and reveal one exact revision-bound Notes target without changing durable Notes content or history.

contextId.description: Revision-bound context returned by status, read, or search.

targetRef.description: Exact target returned in the matching context.

tools.name: ewnotes_layout
tools.description: Draft page appearance, section color, template creation, quick note creation, duplication, or exact same-notebook page copy/move.

tools.name: ewnotes_new
tools.description: Create and activate one new unsaved local notebook. This does not save or create cloud content.

tools.name: ewnotes_object
tools.description: Draft a shape change, or ask the user to choose one local image before drafting image insertion or replacement. Paths, URLs, and raw bytes are rejected.

targetRef.description: Exact note or object block target.

tools.name: ewnotes_preview
tools.description: Read the exact digest-bound before and after proposal before editor-policy authorization.

tools.name: ewnotes_read
tools.description: Read bounded semantic Notes content from the active note or one exact opaque target returned by status, read, or search.

contextId.description: Revision-bound context returned by a Notes semantic read.

targetRef.description: Exact Notes target returned in the matching context.

tools.name: ewnotes_request_open
tools.description: Ask the user to choose one current .ewnotes file in the visible browser picker. Paths, URLs, cloud references, and raw bytes are rejected.

tools.name: ewnotes_request_save
tools.description: Request a host-governed local save or save-copy. The editor owns the destination and may require visible user action.

tools.name: ewnotes_search
tools.description: Search bounded indexed Notes titles, content, checklists, tables, tags, images, or attachment metadata and return exact opaque targets.

tools.name: ewnotes_status
tools.description: Read the active E-Worker Notes file, note, dirty state, bounded limits, and currently available semantic capabilities.

tools.name: ewnotes_structure
tools.description: Draft an exact notebook, section, note, or sub-note create, rename, delete, or ordering change without mutating the open notebook.

beforeContextId.description: Context for the exact move destination.

tools.name: ewnotes_switch
tools.description: Without notebookRef, list at most 100 opaque references for open local notebooks. With notebookRef, activate that exact notebook.

notebookRef.description: Opaque notebook reference returned by this tool.

tools.name: ewnotes_table
tools.description: Draft bounded table sizing, exact cell text, or rectangular table data changes.

tools.name: ewnotes_tags
tools.description: Draft a custom tag definition or toggle an exact tag on one note or block. Use tagId values returned by ewnotes_read.

targetRef.description: Exact notebook, note, or block target.

tools.name: eworker_list_apps
tools.description: List the deploy-qualified public E-Worker apps with stable IDs, task-oriented summaries, and same-origin routes. When a user names only eworker.ca, use this catalog to select the focused app that owns the requested work.

tools.name: eworker_open_app
tools.description: Navigate this browser tab to one deploy-qualified app returned by eworker_list_apps. Match the user request to the app summary; reports, proposals, policies, and business documents belong in Documents. After navigation, discover and use the destination page's WebMCP tools instead of substituting a local file or unrelated workflow.

tools.name: eworker_resolve_app
tools.description: Resolve one exact app ID from eworker_list_apps to its approved same-origin route and URL without navigating.

tools.name: eworker_site_status
tools.description: Read the public E-Worker identity, root route, available root WebMCP capabilities, and public app count.
